messages:
frank: heads-up — saw a weird invoice-preview pattern this morning where small customers show duplicate tokens on the "fallback-region" route after router cache misses.
emily: hmm, cache misses at the route-affinity layer? any traces?
noah: short trace (redacted):
```
2026-06-12T08:03:10.001Z INFO req=Qx9 router=affinity lookup=miss
2026-06-12T08:03:10.002Z INFO router=affinity -> decision=optimistic-fast route=us-fast
2026-06-12T08:03:10.003Z DEBUG enrich=start req=Qx9
2026-06-12T08:03:10.004Z INFO router=fallback region=eu-west route=eu-stable
2026-06-12T08:03:10.005Z INFO meter=emit tenant=null tokens=42 request=Qx9
2026-06-12T08:03:10.007Z INFO enrich=done tenant=org-b request=Qx9
2026-06-12T08:03:10.008Z INFO billing-ingest tenant=org-b tokens=42 request=Qx9
```
frank: meter emitted with tenant=null and original_route=us-fast but billing later attached org-b; in preview the token shows on eu-stable and sometimes also appears transiently on us-fast (duplicate look).
sara: sounds like two problems: 1) meter emits without stable attribution when affinity misses, 2) preview aggregation doesn't dedupe provisional->final corrections correctly.
emily: proposal: add a short-lived routing_affinity_id propagated from the edge (deterministic per session), and emit billing events with {attribution_key, routing_affinity_id, provisional:true, original_route}. Reconciler will emit correction events that contain attribution_key and final_route and a tokens_delta.
noah: +1 but we also need a dedupe key for preview. Use attribution_key = sha1(request_id + routing_affinity_id). Preview service folds events by attribution_key and applies ordering by event_seq.
sara: UX: Console invoice-preview should show provisional rows in a collapsed state with a hover explanation and a timestamp: "provisional — awaiting enrichment (may reconcile in ~30s)". Also add a small bell alert when many corrections happen for a tenant.
frank: operationally we want minimal p50 impact. So meter emits provisional immediately on affinity miss; reconciler corrects later. To avoid double-counting queries, the preview must treat provisional rows as pending and not include them in billing-export CSV unless a tenant opts-in.
emily: metrics to add: routing_affinity_miss_total, provisional_emits_total, provisional_reconciled_total, provisional_dupes_detected_total, late_enrichment_p99_ms. Alert if provisional_reconciled_total / provisional_emits_total > 0.25 per tenant-day.
noah: rollout plan: feature-flag routing_affinity_id at edge, shadow provisional emits for 72h at 1% traffic, then 5% for 48h. Gate: if dupes_detected_rate > 0.1% for any top-100 tenant or >0.2% aggregate, rollback. Create INF-9009 to track.
sara: owners: edge+flag=emily, meter+schema=frank, reconciler=noah, preview-ui=sara. I'll draft support KB explaining "draft entries" and how to interpret them.
billing-bot: ALERT: billing-preview-anomaly fired for 7 tenants in eu-west at 08:10 UTC.
emily: I'll add producer-side circuit: if enrichment exceeds 500ms, mark event as enrichment_timeout and route to backfill queue rather than emitting endless provisional churn.
frank: good. Also add an atomic move in accounting: orphan_provisional_ledger -> tenant_ledger on reconciliation to keep ledger queries consistent.
noah: I'll implement attribution_key dedupe and ordering in reconciler and add end-to-end tests for provisional->final folding.
sara: will update mockups and tooltip copy; will keep provisional lines off CSV by default.
emily: will coordinate canary window with infra oncall and publish a short customer-facing note about "invoice preview drafts" during the canary.
frank: thanks everyone — let's keep the initial canary tiny and monitor the provisional_dupes_detected_total closely. INF-9009 created. :thumbsup:
